nodes.name: Post run command

parameters.body:
=<!-- factory:status -->
**Building.** Start the agent by hand on the Mac, from the Factory repo:

```
scripts/run-manual.sh {{ $('Pick approved issue').first().json.number }}
```

It works on branch `issue-{{ $('Pick approved issue').first().json.number }}` with the latest spec. When the agent is done, push the branch and open a PR with `Closes #{{ $('Pick approved issue').first().json.number }}`. WF3 then moves this issue to `Your QA`.

If the agent has a question, answer it here and set `Approved` again. If it gets stuck, set `Stuck`.

nodes.notes: Basic A: Adam runs the agent. Basic B (T2.4) replaces this with POST /runs.
